Compare Inquiry Navigator plans

Each plan covers one authorised proceeding. Seat limits include the buyer. All three plans include three calendar months of read-only access after the editing period. Renewal is manual.

Inquiry Essential

₹24,999 · Up to 2 users · 6 months of editing

For Committees that need a guided workflow and a clear record of the inquiry.

  • Step-by-step IC/LC workflow with deadline checks and editable Word drafts for notices and hearing records.
  • Neutral question prompts and a basic findings template for Committee completion.
  • POSH Readiness Toolkit and local recovery files to save and resume work.
Buy Inquiry Essential

Inquiry Professional

₹49,999 · Up to 5 users · 9 months of editing

For Committees that need to connect evidence to each allegation and prepare a fuller report.

Includes Essential and adds the following.

  • Allegation-linked evidence and question planning.
  • An editable 44-section draft report and reference checks.
  • Three readiness reviews and Expert Knowledge reference notes.
Buy Inquiry Professional

Inquiry Advanced

₹89,999 · Up to 8 users · 12 months of editing

For Committees handling more complex proceedings, including matters involving multiple parties or a remand.

Includes Professional and adds the following.

  • Question and continuity drafts that use participant codes.
  • Tools to organise the procedural record when an inquiry is reopened or remanded.
  • Procedural challenge scenarios and service-rule profiles.
Buy Inquiry Advanced

Committee members review all drafts and remain responsible for findings and official records.

IC / LC Inquiry Checklist

₹999 for one organisation. Work through 43 checks covering complaint receipt, conciliation, inquiry, reporting, implementation and the annual report. Access lasts 120 days from verified payment.

Build a clear inquiry record that can stand up to scrutiny

The IC / LC Inquiry Checklist helps your Committee check procedural steps, document how both parties were heard, and record the reasons for its findings. A clear record helps the Committee explain and defend its process if the inquiry is challenged in court.

Buy the Inquiry Checklist

Compliance Checklist

₹1,999 for one assessment. Review one workplace or branch for one review year and download the completed report.

Spot POSH compliance gaps early

The POSH Compliance Checklist helps you review your workplace practices and prioritise what needs attention. Addressing gaps early matters because certain employer failures under Section 26(1) of the POSH Act can attract a fine of up to ₹50,000.

Buy the Compliance Checklist
